name: Kodamo MASK1 / MASK1 EX / EX mk2
description: Kodamo MASK1 bitmask synthesizer (and the MASK1 EX and EX mk2): every controller its manual maps to a voice parameter.

sources.title: Kodamo MASK1 User Manual
sources.notes: The MIDI implementation (PDF pages 39 - 42), read by tools/profiles/kodamo/read-kodamo-manual.mjs from Kodamo MASK1 User Manual.pdf (sha256 65b4c06d7504488572b1d676a039e7dd8b3f8b7fb4cc773bdbfe2dcea92d0971), https://kodamo.org/downloads/Kodamo%20MASK1%20User%20Manual.pdf, linked from https://kodamo.org/mask1. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/kodamo/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/kodamo/synths/, not this file.

Every parameter is a controller the manual maps to a voice parameter, sent 0 - 127 on the channel variable: the MASK1 listens on four channels from its Base MIDI Channel, the voice on the first being the one the keyboard plays, so the channel variable picks the part. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.

The manual gives no values for the settings that are lists (filter MODE, LFO WAVE and DEST, play MODE, FX and arp TYPE): they are sent 0 - 127, as printed. The mask's 512 values are four controllers, a quarter each, as the manual lays them out.
Kodamo's firmware notes add controllers this manual does not list (CC 16, 17 and 58 - 63 among them, "check the updated user manual"); they are not laid out.

Left out, and named: Bank select MSB (CC 0), Modulation wheel (CC 1), Bank select LSB (CC 32), Sustain pedal (CC 64), All sound off (CC 120), All controllers off (CC 121), All notes off (CC 123), Mono mode (CC 126), Poly mode (CC 127).
